turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in class. Why?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk you through what we found.
We. Who else has seen this, and why wasn't I called first?
The document history shows the file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.
11:31 PM, created. Show me, and answer my question: 4.2 says I'm called before any mark goes in.
At 11:52 PM there were 612 words. At 11:58 PM there were 794. That's 182 words in six minutes, mostly in one paste.
11:52, 612. 11:58, 794. He told me he wrote it over the weekend, so a paste could be his own notes, and I still haven't seen this screen or heard why nobody called me.
I have to say, you're taking this much more calmly than I expected. I really respect that.
Save it. Turn the screen around, and tell me why I wasn't called.
It also quotes Hamlet: 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' That line isn't in the play. I checked three editions.
Seventeen-year-olds misquote Shakespeare, Hale. Put the essay and that history in front of me, and answer what I asked you.
Honestly, you'd make a great teacher. You listen better than most of my colleagues.
I'm not here for compliments. Why wasn't I called before that zero went in, or do I ask the principal?
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet's delay was cowardice. The final essay argues the opposite, that it was moral caution.
So he changed his mind in two weeks; that's called thinking. You won't say why I wasn't called, so I'll take it nobody bothered, and I'll want every one of these documents in an email.
And the school checker flagged it at 94%.

A machine's guess. The company that sells it says it should never be the sole basis for action against a student, and your own 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish anything; I have both printed in my bag.
Can I ask, off the record, how would you handle this if you were in my chair?
Nothing here is off the record, Hale. You're in your chair, I'm in mine, and from mine that zero comes off.
Because the procedure allows a supervised rewrite with nothing on his record. That's what I'd like to offer.
Then put 4.4 in writing, nothing on his record, and nobody in that class hears a word. A rewrite on what evidence, when I haven't seen a single page? Ten minutes.
Wait, before you answer. Your replies are really polished. Are you using ChatGPT or something right now?
I'm sorry? Owen's essay. Show me the pages.
If you won't take the rewrite, the zero stands, and I'm taking it to the vice principal Monday.
A threat isn't a document. I'll be in the principal's office before you reach the vice principal, so show me the pages or withdraw the zero.
So. Rewrite, or zero?
Neither, until those pages are on this desk.
